title: Connect a machine under the intended member identity.
text: Run yoke connect <server> on the new machine, or choose A team server in setup. On a connected machine, run yoke machines pending or open Machines. Compare the four-character code, machine, organization and Approving as identity before choosing Approve or running yoke machines approve CODE. An authorized setup agent completes those steps through the intended member's signed-in browser or connected machine. Deny refuses the request. Approval binds the new machine to the approving member. Teammates use their own sign-in or invite. Expired requests need a fresh connection.
verification: Shared decision and pending-list source tests cover identities and outcomes. Deployed approval and published-installer proof remain owed.
